column1: # Per-application settings of run_app_e2e.sh. Tab-separated; '-' = default.
#   app          name of the run (JDD outPutDirName, fuzzer APP_NAME); dataset apps use JDD/IOCDDatasets/detected/<app> names
#   jars         jar set under $DATA_JARS = the application's run-time classpath (the fuzzer's inputClassPath)
#   analyze      glob(s) of the jars in that set JDD analyses, comma-separated (default: all of them)
#   sinks        JDD sinkRules; '+file' = the default set plus file          (default: exec,invoke,jndi,classLoad,custom)
#   jdd_set      further JDD config.properties overrides, space-separated k=v (default: none)
#   jdd_timeout  wall-clock limit of the JDD analysis in seconds              (default: 3600)
# Fileupload: only the file sink (its known chain, FileUpload1, writes a file; the other sinks only add JDK-internal
# RMI/JNDI chains there). Wicket: the default sinks plus file; with the file sink alone JDD reported 1000 chains (its
# prioritizedGadgetChainLimit), 999 of them through JDK classes only.
# protocol and sinks follow the sink types and protocol of the app's IOCDs in JDD/IOCDDatasets/detected/ (e.g. FILE
# IOCDs => 'file' among the sinks). Which jars the paper's JDD runs analysed is not recorded there: all run-time jars
